key.name: auto-connect
key.description: When on, keep asking the Jabra Link dongle to connect its remembered headset until it is connected. Toggled by clicking the top-bar icon.

key.name: pause-on-disconnect
key.summary: Pause media when the headset disconnects
key.description: Pause playing media players (MPRIS) when the headset disconnects while the Jabra Link is the sound output.

key.name: headset-name
key.description: Part of the remembered headset's name to auto-connect. Empty means the first remembered headset.
